title: Law to require delivery apps and couriers to get a city license
summary: This bill would require delivery services that arrange for delivery of goods in New York City to obtain a business license from the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection, replacing the current narrower rules that cover only third-party food delivery services. It sets licensing conditions and enforcement options and would take effect 180 days after becoming law. The bill was heard alongside other micromobility and delivery-related bills at a September 30, 2026 Council hearing.
